description: B03: Fit and evaluate three calibration methods (isotonic, logistic, temperature) on Jev System-1 outputs across four benchmark datasets

holdout.reason: Holdout is strictly forbidden from being loaded or evaluated during B03.

arm_ids.reason: B03 is a calibration fitting batch on System-1 outputs; handoff arms (F0, F1, C0, C1) are evaluated in B04/B05.

generation_parameters.reason: B03 consumes already-collected B02 predictions; no new LLM generation or prompts are executed.

acceptance_criteria: All three calibration methods fit strictly on calibration split (1,856 samples)
Holdout split (6,496 samples) is blocked and never accessed
Parameters are portable and serializable in parameters.json without external binary objects
CLINC150 temperature scaling fits strictly on ID samples (300 calibration ID samples)
CLINC150 error risk calibration targets mixed-pool application error using tau* = 0.159485
Model selection evaluates macro unweighted selection error Brier against raw 1-p1 baseline
Tie-breaker prioritizes isotonic, then registration order
At most one routing method family is selected for B04; if none beats baseline, null is recorded
Downstream handoff payload preserves raw Jev probabilities without overwriting with e_hat

decision_rules.rule_1_strictly_lower_logistic: if Brier(logistic) < Brier(isotonic) then select logistic
decision_rules.rule_2_strictly_lower_isotonic: if Brier(isotonic) < Brier(logistic) then select isotonic
decision_rules.rule_3_tie_breaker: if Brier(logistic) == Brier(isotonic) then select isotonic
decision_rules.rule_4_baseline_hurdle: winner Brier must be strictly lower than raw 1-p1 Brier, otherwise select null (no calibrated routing candidate)
decision_rules.scope_boundary: Only determines optional calibrated routing candidate for B04; never alters primary 1-p1 escalation mask nor replaces raw probabilities in F1/C1 handoff payload
